basis: Fit-first assessment from the complete 26-program Travelpayouts Available inventory shown by the operator. Commission is secondary to ERN visitor utility and editorial fit.

strategy.principle: Camera quality and live/current truth come first. Commercial usefulness may help prioritize destinations, but never changes editorial ranking or truth labels.
cameraPrioritySignals: Major tourist cities with strong live/current street, skyline or landmark views
Arrival cities where airport transfer is a natural next step
Walkable historic centers where tours and luggage storage are useful
Island/coastal/road-trip destinations where car or bike rental is useful
Asia destinations with strong activities/experience inventory

programs.name: Klook
programs.cameraSignal: Prioritize strong live/current views in major tourist cities, landmarks and day-trip hubs.

programs.name: Tiqets
programs.cameraSignal: Prioritize landmark, museum-district and iconic attraction views.

programs.name: KKday
programs.cameraSignal: Strong Asia-led destination signal; useful for cities, attractions, food and connectivity.

programs.name: Go City
programs.cameraSignal: Favor cities with dense attraction clusters and multi-attraction visitor behavior.

programs.name: WeGoTrip
programs.cameraSignal: Useful for walkable historic centers, museums and self-guided-tour destinations.

programs.name: Welcome Pickups
programs.cameraSignal: Favor major arrival cities/airports where a live city view can lead naturally into transfer planning.

programs.name: Kiwitaxi
programs.cameraSignal: Alternate transfer partner for major arrival destinations; avoid duplicate placement where Welcome Pickups already fits.

programs.name: intui.travel
programs.cameraSignal: Another useful transfer layer for destinations not covered well by existing transfer partners.

programs.name: Radical Storage
programs.cameraSignal: Excellent for train-station, downtown and walkable-city windows where luggage storage solves an immediate visitor need.

programs.name: Localrent.com
programs.cameraSignal: Useful in island, coastal and road-trip destinations where car rental is a natural next action.

programs.name: GetRentacar.com
programs.cameraSignal: Good road-trip/island signal; avoid crowding destinations already served by another car-rental partner.

programs.name: QEEQ
programs.cameraSignal: Useful for car-dependent destinations; potentially strong for U.S., Australia, islands and scenic drives.

programs.name: Economybookings.com
programs.cameraSignal: Same strategic role as other car-rental partners; use only where coverage or economics justify it.

programs.name: AutoEurope (EU,UK)
programs.cameraSignal: Useful Europe/UK road-trip signal, especially for scenic regions and secondary cities.

programs.name: BikesBooking.com
programs.cameraSignal: Good for bike-friendly cities, islands and resort areas where micro-mobility fits the place.

programs.name: Aviasales
programs.cameraSignal: Useful as an onward-travel layer, but not a reason by itself to choose a camera location.

programs.name: Kiwi.com
programs.cameraSignal: Flight planning is useful but less connected to the immediate live-view moment.

programs.name: Airalo
programs.cameraSignal: Connectivity is globally useful but should not shape camera geography.

programs.name: Yesim
programs.cameraSignal: Same utility role as other eSIM partners; select at most one or two later.

programs.name: GigSky
programs.cameraSignal: Global utility, low camera-selection value.

programs.name: Drimsim
programs.cameraSignal: Connectivity utility only; not a camera-selection driver.

programs.name: Saily
programs.cameraSignal: Connectivity utility only; useful later if one eSIM partner is selected.

programs.name: AirHelp
programs.cameraSignal: Post-disruption utility; commercially useful but unrelated to camera selection.

programs.name: Compensair
programs.cameraSignal: Same recovery role as AirHelp; avoid duplication.

programs.name: EKTA
programs.cameraSignal: Travel-protection utility; should never drive editorial or camera selection.

programs.name: GetTransfer.com
programs.cameraSignal: Potentially useful transfer option, but overlap is high; reserve for coverage gaps.
